title: Retrieval design
text: Retrieval augmented generation should first rank relevant source passages, then pass those passages to the response workflow. Low retrieval confidence should trigger a graceful no-evidence answer rather than inventing facts.

title: Python debugging workflow
text: When Python tests fail, reproduce the smallest failing input, inspect the traceback, identify the responsible function, add or update a focused regression test, and rerun pytest.

title: Streamlit session state
text: Streamlit reruns the script after interactions. Values that must survive reruns belong in st.session_state. A new game should explicitly reset attempts, score, status, history, and the secret.

title: Reliability testing
text: Reliability is checked with automated tests, confidence scores, validation for missing input, and logs that record execution and failures. Evidence should be cited when possible.
